steps.say: Peel it up, rinse it in the tub.
Scrub the cups in hot soapy water.
Hang it up to dry fully.

safety.say: One cleaner only. Never mix cleaners.
safety.text: One cleaner only. Never mix cleaners.

safetyCheck: Checked 2026-11-05: washing-up liquid and hot water only, one product at a time; no bleach, no vinegar+bleach, no ammonia, no acid+bleach, nothing mixed. Rubber/PVC suction mats: check the care label before any machine wash (low temp, no tumble dryer). Bin a mat with mould that won't scrub off. Wear gloves for mouldy mats and ventilate the bathroom.
